Row.Text: As empires rise and fall, Joseon persists. In the calm behind its fleets of turtle ships, Joseon builds a society that balances Confucian meritocracy and kingship, a harmonious order as all else seems to fall. Hold the line, stand firm, and let Joseon thrive.
Joseon has a unique statistic called City Limit. This is literally a limit on the number of Settlements that can be turned into Cities, so plan carefully!
